w10_T4_002537: Two friends, Maria and Julio, tracked reward points during a weekend charity challenge, and Julio's total stayed far below hers all day. Maria started the morning with 191 points, then earned 78 more before noon for completing a puzzle station. In the afternoon, a penalty deducted 164 points after a rules violation, and a referee's review cost her 4 more points shortly after. In the evening, a bonus challenge added 56 points to her score. Right before the final scoring, a special multiplier made her tally grow to 8 times its size. At the very end, a closing penalty cost her 586 points all at once. What was Maria's final score?
w10_T4_002541: A science class started an experiment with 84 bacteria in a petri dish, and their lab assistant kept a dozen spare dishes on a shelf just in case, though those were never used. During the first growth cycle, the colony grew to 4 times its size. During the second growth cycle, it grew to 4 times its size again. During the third growth cycle, it grew to 4 times its size once more. Finally, a nutrient boost caused one last growth spurt, bringing the colony to 7 times its size. How many bacteria were in the dish after the final spurt?
w10_T4_002543: On fundraiser day, 6 classrooms each collected 161 dollars for the school library by mid-morning, and their totals were combined into one grand jar. In the afternoon, 25 dollars had to be refunded to a parent who had overpaid by mistake. A local business then donated 74 more dollars to the jar, while the event organizer's 500 unused raffle tickets sat forgotten in a drawer. That evening, a matching-gift program doubled the jar's total. Right before the bank deposit, a second matching donor tripled that new total once more. Since the treasurer recorded everything in dollars but the bank statement listed amounts in cents, she always double-checked the conversion before submitting the deposit. How much money was in the jar for the final deposit?
w10_T4_002549: A music school opened the morning with 6 practice rooms, each holding 77 minutes worth of booked lessons on the schedule. By late morning, a scheduling change canceled 417 minutes worth of lessons across the rooms. In the afternoon, 23 more minutes were cut when a teacher called in sick. Since the front desk logs lesson time in minutes but the tuition invoice converts it into hours, the receptionist always double-checked the math before billing. In the evening, a makeup session added 18 more minutes to the schedule. How many minutes of lessons remained on the schedule by evening?
w10_T4_002554: A stadium box office started the day with 4 windows open, each having sold 133 tickets before the gates opened. A separate souvenir stand, which had 200 unsold t-shirts left over from last season, wasn't part of the ticket count. Once the gates opened, 10 more tickets were sold to walk-up fans. During halftime, 26 more tickets were sold at a discount. After a printing error voided some sales, 69 tickets had to be refunded. How many valid tickets were sold in total?
w10_T4_002555: A community garden started with 50 tomato seedlings, and a nearby group had a dozen extra flower pots that were never used in this plot. The seedlings were divided evenly among 5 garden beds, and only one bed's seedlings were tracked afterward. A neighbor then paid for enough new seedlings to grow that bed's count to 6 times its size. A rainy week helped 6 more seedlings sprout successfully. By midsummer, a seed swap added 58 more seedlings to the bed. A final growth spurt right before harvest made the bed's total grow to 7 times its size. How many tomato seedlings were in that bed at harvest time?
w10_T4_002561: A charity book drive began the morning with 193 books donated, and a volunteer coordinator doubled that count by tracking down matching donations from a partner school. By afternoon, 60 more books arrived from a local library's surplus. In the evening, 45 more books came in from a neighborhood collection bin. Right before the drive closed for the night, a last matching-donor pledge doubled the total once more. How many books had been collected by the time the drive closed?
w10_T4_002562: A warehouse inventory log showed 234 crates of canned goods at the start of the morning shift. By midmorning, 18 more crates arrived from a supplier. In the afternoon, another delivery brought in 38 more crates. Later, 89 crates were shipped out to a regional store. Since the warehouse tracks weight in kilograms but crates are counted individually, the manager kept a separate unit-conversion sheet just for billing. By evening, a final delivery added 74 more crates. How many crates were in the warehouse by the end of the evening?
w10_T4_002567: A food bank started the morning with 145 pounds of rice in storage. By midmorning, 120 pounds were distributed to local families. The remaining rice was then repackaged into 8 equally sized batches for a partner shelter, and the total delivered equaled all 8 batches combined. In the afternoon, a grocery store donated 8 more pounds, and later that day a farm delivered 27 more pounds. Since the food bank logs weight in pounds but its national report converts everything to kilograms, staff always double-checked the numbers before submitting it. By evening, a final donation added 74 more pounds. How many pounds of rice did the food bank have by evening?
w10_T4_002573: A toy store began the morning with 122 puzzle boxes on the shelf. By afternoon, 34 boxes had been sold to customers. A back-room delivery then made the remaining stock grow to 4 times its size. The store manager, who had ordered 90 extra shopping bags that never got used, wasn't worried about the backlog. That evening, a clearance return brought in 74 more boxes. Overnight, the boxes were split evenly across 3 storage shelves, and only one shelf's count was tracked going forward. How many puzzle boxes were on that shelf the next morning?
w10_T4_002575: A factory started production with 5 machines, each producing 190 gears in the morning batch, while the plant manager kept a dozen spare toolkits in a locker that were never opened that day. The gears were then packed into 8 identical crates of equal size for shipping. A quality check rejected 7535 gears due to a batch of defective metal. A supplier delivered 55 replacement gears to make up part of the loss. Finally, the remaining gears were divided evenly across 6 regional warehouses, and only one warehouse's shipment was tracked. How many gears were sent to that warehouse?
w10_T4_002580: Two coworkers, Nadia and Percy, competed in a step-count challenge, and Percy always fell behind her totals throughout the week. Nadia logged 157 minutes of walking by the morning check-in. By midmorning, 30 minutes were deducted after her tracker glitched. In the afternoon, she added 66 more minutes on a long walk. That evening, a bonus challenge made her total grow to 4 times its size. Right before the challenge ended, a final scoring round made it grow to 9 times its size once more. The app then split her final total evenly across 4 weekly summaries, and only the last week's number counted for the prize. How many minutes did that final week show for Nadia?
w10_T4_002581: Two roommates, Dana and Wes, split grocery costs, and Wes always contributed less than she did each month. Dana's grocery budget started the month at 101 dollars, and a bonus paycheck doubled that amount right away. She then spent 143 dollars stocking up on pantry staples. A car repair bill drained another 53 dollars from what was left. Since her banking app tracks spending in dollars but rounds transaction history to the nearest cent for statements, she always checked the fine print. A final bonus grew her remaining balance to 6 times its size. How much money did Dana have left in her grocery budget?
w10_T4_002588: A charity auction started the morning with 123 dollars in the collection box. By mid-morning, a generous bidder added 73 more dollars. At midday, the auctioneer announced a matching-fund event that made the box's total grow to 9 times its size. In the early afternoon, 15 more dollars came in from a raffle. By late afternoon, 33 more dollars were added from ticket sales. In the evening, 11 more dollars came from a bake sale table. Right before closing for the night, a final donor added 65 more dollars. How much money was in the collection box at closing?
w10_T4_002590: Two rival lemonade stands, run by Grace and Theo, competed all summer, and Theo's daily sales never came close to hers. Grace's stand started the summer selling 175 cups on day one, and a promotional deal made her weekly total grow to 9 times as large. A follow-up viral video made that total grow to 6 times its size. A local news feature then added 44 more cups sold. A citywide fair let her multiply that number by featuring her stand at 8 identical fair booths, each selling that same amount. Afterward, 10 more cups were sold at a bonus pop-up event. Finally, a last-minute rush added 66 more cups. How many cups had Grace sold in total?
w10_T4_002593: A beekeeper checked her hive box with 53 jars of honey ready in the morning. By midmorning, 48 jars had already been sold at the farmers market. Later, 1 more jar cracked and had to be discarded. In the afternoon, a bulk order required her to prepare 3 times as many jars as she had left, so she refilled the shelf accordingly. That evening, 11 jars were given away as free samples at a community event. How many jars of honey were left by evening?
w10_T4_002596: Two stamp collectors, Leo and Priti, compared their collections at a convention, and Leo's was noticeably smaller than hers. Priti's album held 160 stamps at the start of the convention, and a trade with another collector added 52 more stamps. A rare-set bonus then made her collection grow to 9 times its size. A special exhibit prize made it grow to 9 times its size once again, while the organizer's 3000 extra entry passes sat unused in a box. Afterward, 14004 stamps had to be returned to their rightful owners after an authentication review found they didn't belong to her. How many stamps remained in Priti's album?
w10_T4_002599: A charity raffle sold tickets across 5 identical booths, each booth collecting 211 dollars by the end of the morning. An extra donation added 11 more dollars to the combined total. A processing fee of 353 dollars was then deducted before the funds could be transferred. A matching-grant program made the remaining total grow to 7 times its size. A final citywide match then made that new total grow to 4 times its size. How much money did the raffle ultimately raise?
w10_T4_002608: Two shop owners, Isla and Ravi, tracked their coin drawer totals all day, and Ravi's drawer stayed noticeably lower than hers. Isla's drawer held 171 dollars at the start of the morning, and by midmorning, 11 more dollars came in from early customers. At midday, a bulk sale event made her total grow to 3 times its size. In the afternoon, 54 more dollars came in from a big order. Since her register logs everything in dollars and cents but the bank statement lists whole-dollar figures only, she always rounded carefully before her evening deposit, when the drawer's total was split evenly across 6 cash envelopes and only one envelope was tracked into the next day. Overnight, a matching bonus made that envelope grow to 6 times its size, and a final coupon reimbursement added 13 more dollars the next morning. How much money was in that envelope by the next morning?
w10_T4_002622: Two hikers, Bianca and Omar, tracked their trail snack supply, and Omar always packed less than she did. Bianca started the hike with 111 granola bars in her pack, and by the first rest stop, 22 bars had been eaten by the group. A cache resupply added 63 more bars to her pack, while their guide's 200 extra water purification tablets went completely unused. Later, 141 bars were given out to a scout troop they met on the trail. Near the summit, a fellow hiker gave her 78 more bars. On the way down, 15 bars were left behind at a ranger station donation box. How many granola bars did Bianca have left?
w10_T4_002635: Two food trucks, run by Camila and Deshawn, kept tally of tacos served, and Deshawn's count trailed hers most days. Camila's truck sold 186 tacos on Friday morning. By lunchtime, 32 more tacos were sold. In the early afternoon, 41 more went out the window. By late afternoon, a rush of returns and cancellations reduced her count by 257 tacos. A dinner-hour promotion then made her remaining total grow to 6 times its size. Right before closing, 18 more tacos were sold to a large group. How many tacos had Camila sold by closing?
w10_T4_002639: A bottling plant ran 9 identical machines each morning, and every machine filled 206 bottles of juice before the first break. By midmorning, 891 bottles were shipped out to a distributor. The plant's quality lab, which tested 50 random bottles from an unrelated batch that morning, wasn't part of this shipment count. In the afternoon, 77 more bottles were pulled for a recall check. Since the plant measures volume in liters but counts bottles individually for shipping logs, the supervisor always kept both units on the same sheet. By evening, 522 more bottles were shipped to a second distributor. How many bottles remained at the plant by evening?
w10_T4_002641: A charity blood drive began the morning with 96 pints donated, while the hospital's separate supply closet held a dozen unopened testing kits that weren't used that day. By midmorning, 40 more pints came in. At midday, 43 more pints were donated. In the afternoon, 64 more pints arrived from a mobile unit. By evening, 61 more pints were donated at a community center. A regional shortage alert then required the blood bank to grow its stock to 9 times its size for redistribution. Late that night, a final donation added 64 more pints. How many pints were in the blood bank's stock after the final donation?
w10_T4_002642: Two warehouse managers, Fatima and Colby, compared their shipment logs, and Colby's numbers were always smaller than hers. Fatima's warehouse processed 6 loading docks, each handling 191 packages that morning. A regional surge then made the day's total grow to 9 times its size. Since the warehouse tracks weight in kilograms but counts packages individually for the shipping manifest, Fatima always cross-checked both figures before signing off. That afternoon, 5216 packages were shipped out to fulfill a major order. By evening, 776 more packages went out for local deliveries. How many packages were left in Fatima's warehouse by evening?
w10_T4_002644: A candle-making workshop began the morning with 158 candles cooling on racks. By midmorning, 45 candles were sold directly to walk-in customers. A wholesale order then required the workshop to prepare 7 times as many candles as remained, and a second, larger order right after that required 7 times that new amount. Since the workshop measures wax in ounces but sells finished candles by the piece, the owner kept separate tally sheets for each, and in the afternoon a shipping error caused 4454 candles to be returned as damaged. A make-up production run that evening grew the remaining stock to 6 times its size, and a final custom order added 23 more candles overnight. How many candles were ready by the next morning?
